title: Classification with Large-Step Gradient Descent: Unifying Self-Stabilization and Convergence Rates
abstract: arXiv:2611.17459v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural networks are often trained with gradient descent (GD) using step sizes that exceed classical stability thresholds, a regime where standard convergence theory no longer applies. Despite exhibiting non-monotonic loss and oscillatory dynamics, this regime frequently leads to faster convergence and better generalization. Existing theoretical perspectives offer complementary but incomplete insights: one identifies a self-stabilization mechanism that drives GD toward flat regions but does not yield convergence rates; another derives rigorous rates for specific losses but does not explain the underlying stabilization mechanism; and a third unifies these views for overparameterized least squares, but relies on the existence of a minimizer manifold, which is absent in classification settings. In this work, we extend this unified geometric perspective to exponential-tail losses, including logistic and cross-entropy losses in separable linea

translated_title: 基于大步长梯度下降的分类：统一自稳定机制与收敛速率
translated_abstract: 神经网络通常使用超过经典稳定性阈值的步长进行梯度下降（GD）训练，在这种情形下，标准的收敛理论不再适用。尽管该情形表现出非单调的损失和振荡的动力学，但它往往能带来更快的收敛速度和更好的泛化性能。现有的理论视角提供了互补但不完整的见解：一种视角识别出自稳定机制，该机制驱动梯度下降趋向平坦区域，但无法给出收敛速率；另一种视角针对特定损失推导出了严格的收敛速率，但没有解释其背后的稳定机制；第三种视角针对过参数化最小二乘问题统一了上述观点，但其依赖于极小值流形的存在，而这一流形在分类问题中并不存在。在这项工作中，我们将这一统一的几何视角扩展到具有指数尾部的损失函数，包括可分线性分类中的逻辑损失和交叉熵损失……
tldr: 本文将统一的几何视角扩展到指数尾损失（如逻辑损失和交叉熵损失），首次在分类设定下将大步长梯度下降的自稳定机制与收敛速率分析统一起来。
en_tdlr: This paper extends the unified geometric perspective to exponential-tail losses (e.g., logistic and cross-entropy), unifying self-stabilization and convergence rates of large-step gradient descent in classification settings.
